question.text: Under the Indian Stamp Rules, 2019, the responsibility for collection of stamp duty on transactions by the transferor of securities in the depository system lies with:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the Indian Stamp Rules, 2019, stamp duty collection for transferor transactions or issuer issuance in the depository system is the responsibility of the depository. The Trap: Stock exchanges, stock brokers, and clearing corporations handle other aspects of transactions; the depository is specifically assigned this stamp-duty collection role. Note: This rule came into force with effect from April 1, 2020, per the source page footnote.
